entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Billiards can be so fun! Especially[n]when you're able to hit the ball[n]you were going for!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm so glad you're having fun Lady Ann.[n]I couldn't be happier that we invited you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now, the reason I called you guys here[n]is to strengthen the Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm calling it "Operation Billiards"!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What kinda mission name is that!?[n]It's way too straight forward!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What's important is the mood!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, you guys know a technique[n]in billiards called the Trick Shot?
Is it a magic trick?
I don't.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, it's kinda like that.[n]It's an attack that seems like magic!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh... Well, it's basically something[n]just as cool as magic is.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You know how we learned different[n]tactics by playing darts in pairs?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So with billiards, instead of just[n]playing normally... Let's try doing[n]some trick shots.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Okay. I think I get it, but what[n]kinda shot is it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Great question, Lady Ann!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right Ryuji, I'll explain so get[n]those balls ready.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, yeah. Just order[n]me around, you cat.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right! I think our bodies are warmed[n]up enough. Let's try those trick shots!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Nice! That was a perfect jump shot!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Good going! That behind-the-[n]back shot looked amazing!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now that's what I call a massé shot!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I think I get it... Guess it's time for[n]us to give it a go.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Y-You almost had it! Dang it, I think my[n]life just got shortened a little bit.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That was quite a trip...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You should probably cool that off.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Welp, it's no fun if we succeed[n]super quick anyways. Let's get some[n]more practice.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We're having fun and training at the[n]same time. My plan worked out perfectly.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: C'mon, guys. Let's get outta here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The power of the Phantom Thieves[n]are really starting to shine through.[n]You guys better be thanking me!
